user: I avoid using smartphones or tablets for educational purposes.
assistant:  That's perfectly fine! While smartphones and tablets can be useful tools for education, they are not the only ways to learn. There are many other methods and tools you can use to continue your education. Here are a few suggestions:

1. Laptop or desktop computer: If you prefer not to use a smartphone or tablet, you might consider using a laptop or desktop computer instead. These devices can be just as effective for educational purposes, and they often offer more functionality and flexibility than mobile devices.
2. Books and print materials: There is still a lot to be said for the value of books and other print materials when it comes to learning. Libraries and bookstores are full of resources that can help you learn about a wide variety of topics.
3. Online courses: There are many online platforms that offer courses on a wide range of subjects. These courses can be accessed from any device with an internet connection, so you don't need to use a smartphone or tablet to participate.
